fields.description: Issue includes local nightlife and entertainment listings and advertisements, radio schedules, and society/gossip columns ("They Tell Me" and "I'd Like to Know"). Coverage includes sports and racing news and tips (horse racing and dog racing, including Hialeah and other tracks), discussion of racing figures and alleged fixing, and notices about the National Tennis Club and the Wine & Liquor Exposition. Also includes business and civic items such as NRA-related statements by motor vehicle dealers and letters to the editor about employment and local hiring.
